clips.title: The story
paras: Lumak sends you from Orgrimmar to find his friend Nat Pagle. Your skill has outgrown ordinary lessons, and Nat camps on a distant islet south of Theramore Isle.

Lumak trains fishers in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He sees that you have learned all he can teach about rod and reel, and admits you are too good for ordinary lessons. To learn the art of artisan fishing, you must seek knowledge beyond the city and the Horde.

Lumak sends you to find his human friend, Nat Pagle. He warns you not to harm or eat Nat, despite the friction between the Horde and Alliance across Kalimdor. Nat camps on an islet south of Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He keeps clear of politics and cares only whether the fish are biting.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lumak no can teach friend no more. You too good! Find Lumak friend, Nat Pagle. Is human but no eat! Is Lumak friend! Nat teach you fish gooder.
You find Nat in Dustwallow Marsh, south of Humie town, Thermorosomethinglikedat. Nat probably fishing. Go now!

clips.title: Completion
paras: 'Course, you must be a friend of Lumak's.
Fishin'? I can tell you all 'bout fishin'.
